virgil.songTitle: The Night They Drove Old Dixie Down
virgil.linePrev: When one day she called to me
virgil.line: "Virgil, quick, come see, there goes Robert E.Lee"
virgil.lineNext: Now I don't mind choppin' wood
stanza: Back with my wife in Tennessee
When one day she called to me
"Virgil, quick, come see, there goes Robert E.Lee"
Now I don't mind choppin' wood
And I don't care if the money's no good
Ya take what ya need and ya leave the rest
But they should never have taken the very best

virgil.songTitle: The Night They Drove Old Dixie Down
virgil.line: Virgil Caine is the name, and I served on the Danville train
virgil.lineNext: 'Til Stonewall's cavalry came and tore up the tracks again
stanza: Virgil Caine is the name, and I served on the Danville train
'Til Stonewall's cavalry came and tore up the tracks again
In the winter of '65, we were hungry, just barely alive
By May the tenth, Richmond had fell
It's a time I remember, oh so well
